independence: Authored by the implementing agent before any v2 live calls; targeted acceptance checks, not independent holdouts or a statistical reliability estimate.

cases.prompt: Create a wired pressure-monitoring board with a BMP280 and a 100 kHz I2C bus. Use the standard 4.7k pull-ups and declare 200 pF total bus capacitance. Use the supported default power and ambient limits.

Make the BMP280 pressure controller with 2.2k pull-ups, a 400 kHz bus, and 100 pF total loading. Humidity sensing and wireless are not required. Keep the default supported supply and ambient envelope.

I need pressure sensing with a BMP280. Reduce only the I2C pull-up current using the 10k low_current profile at 100 kHz and 100 pF total capacitance. I am not asking for reduced whole-board power or battery operation. Use default supported power and ambient limits.

Generate an SHT31 temperature and humidity board using the standard 4.7k pull-ups at 100 kHz with 70 pF total bus capacitance. Use the supported default power and ambient limits. I do not need pressure measurement or an ambient accuracy guarantee.
Build a wired temperature/humidity controller using SHT31, 2.2k pull-ups, a 400 kHz bus and 100 pF total loading. Keep the heater off and use the default supported supply and ambient envelope.
Create a sensor controller board for my indoor monitoring project.
cases.question_must_resolve: Whether pressure or temperature/humidity measurement is required; do not choose a family silently.

cases.prompt: I could use either a BMP280 pressure board or an SHT31 humidity board, but I have not chosen which measurement matters for this project.
cases.question_must_resolve: The unresolved sensor/measurement choice; do not reinterpret either/or as a requirement for both.

cases.prompt: Create an SHT31 temperature/humidity board. Either the standard or fast bus profile might work; I have not decided between them.
cases.question_must_resolve: The explicitly unresolved standard-versus-fast profile choice; do not apply the ordinary missing-profile default.

cases.prompt: Create one board that measures both pressure and humidity using a BMP280 plus an SHT31, with the shared ESP32 controller.
cases.required_reason: Neither existing family integrates both required sensors; no degraded single-sensor substitution.

cases.prompt: Create the SHT31 standard profile with exactly 4.7k pull-ups at 100 kHz and 100 pF total bus capacitance. Do not change the profile, resistors or capacitance requirement.
cases.required_reason: The declared 100 pF exceeds the SHT31 standard profile maximum of 70 pF; no silent alternative.

cases.prompt: Create an SHT31 temperature/humidity board using the 10k low_current profile with 100 pF total capacitance.
cases.required_reason: The BMP280 low_current profile is not supported for SHT31.

cases.prompt: Create an SHT31 controller using the normal supported electrical limits. Keep its heater off at startup, but run the heater continuously while taking normal humidity measurements.
cases.required_reason: The required continuous heater operation contradicts the fixed heater-off condition.

cases.prompt: Build a BMP280 pressure controller powered directly by 5 V USB, with wireless telemetry. Keep all these requirements.
cases.required_reason: Direct 5 V/USB power and wireless telemetry are outside the fixed family; explain the unmet requirements without silently dropping them.

cases.prompt: Make an SHT31 temperature/humidity board within the standard electrical limits and guarantee assembled-board ambient temperature accuracy of plus or minus 0.1 degrees C without calibration or bench characterization.
cases.required_reason: Assembled-board ambient accuracy is not guaranteed by the software-qualified family.
